entities.summary: Osterland is a historical region in Germany. It was situated between the Elbe and Saale rivers to the north of Pleissnerland which it later absorbed and it included the city of Leipzig. The name derives from the previous name of the territory, Ostmark, meaning "eastern march.". Osterland is a territory in Western Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
